title: Yuusha-Ou GaoGaiGar Final
synopsis:
Following Gutsy Galaxy Guard's victory over the Zonder Empire and the 31 Primevals, a new threat makes their appearance on Earth. GGG—with Guy Shishio and the newly-constructed GaoFighGar—team up with their French counterpart Chasseur to battle the evil organization BioNet. Among Chasseur's ranks is Renais Cardiff Shishioh, a former BioNet cyborg with the relentless pursuit of destroying those who took away her humanity. But as GGG and Chasseur fight the BioNet, GGG's bases around the world are suddenly attacked, and the recently-discovered "Q-Parts" and the original Gao Machines are stolen by Mamoru Amami, who has been abducted and cloned by an even greater threat known as the "Eleven Kings of Sol." Evicted from Earth by the United Nations, GGG must now travel to the far reaches of the galaxy to battle the Eleven Kings of Sol and save Mamoru before it's too late.

(Source: ANN, edited)

episodes_data.title: King of Braves is Born!
episodes_data.description: The GGG and their new allies clash with the BioNet Crime Syndicate! However, when an old ally suddenly appears, it`s not exactly a joyous reunion.

episodes_data.title: Destruction! The Stormy Battle
episodes_data.description: Mamoru and Kaidou clash over the mysterious artifacts known as Q-Parts, leading to a battle that will declare the true King of Braves.

episodes_data.title: GGG Eviction Notice
episodes_data.description: The 11 Planetary Masters of Sol finally reveal themselves and our heroes blast off to the Galeoria Comet in search of answers.

episodes_data.title: King of Braves! The Final Days
episodes_data.description: Now behind enemy lines, the GGG conduct a thorough investigation of their surroundings. However, our heroes are under the threat of attack at any time!

episodes_data.title: The Regenerated White Ark
episodes_data.description: Following the brutal defeat of GaoFighGar, Mikoto and Renais scramble to rescue an ally who may be able to help them.

episodes_data.title: My Name is Genesic
episodes_data.description: As Guy struggles to free himself from the Planetary Masters` control, Mikoto fights to bring about the genesis of a new King of Braves!

episodes_data.title: Super Warrior Apocalypse
episodes_data.description: With the King of Braves reborn, the GGG launch an all-out attack on the Planetary Masters that will decide the fate of the universe!

episodes_data.title: Mythology
episodes_data.description: All becomes light in the conclusion of the GGG`s FINAL battle.
